provenance.sampleData: Synthetic and sanitized example.com authentication traffic

claimBoundaries: The extension analyzes browser-visible Microsoft Edge DevTools and imported Chromium NetLog evidence.
JWT and certificate data is decoded and summarized but not cryptographically validated.
Client authentication token values remain hidden.
Server-to-server, KDC, and backend-only exchanges may not be visible.
